summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js, a single-line, 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator, `_0x` identifier scheme) shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js is not declared in package.json `files` (which lists only ["bin","dist","src"]) and has no relationship to the advertised Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin functionality. On `npm install`, the preinstall fires automatically and runs the obfuscated payload under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host outside the visibility of Node-based tooling. The undeclared payload, alien-runtime execution path, and obfuscation together indicate a compromised or impersonating publish rather than a legitimate release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
